description: A 2019 systematic review and meta-analysis found prenatal stress associated with ASD at pooled OR 1.64 (95% CI 1.15-2.34, 15 studies) and ADHD at OR 1.72 (95% CI 1.27-2.34, 12 studies). Heterogeneity was very high - I-squared 90% and 85% - which is a real caveat, not a footnote.
energy_note: Risk up by roughly two thirds. Not a cause.

description: A Swedish register study of 553,766 children born 2006-2010 found prenatal maternal PTSD associated with offspring ADHD at crude OR 1.79 (1.37-2.34). Importantly, in children with indicators of heredity the association was partly explained by it - genetic confounding accounts for some of it.
energy_note: Partly the war, partly the family. Both are true.

description: The placenta modulates fetal exposure to maternal glucocorticoids, but becomes less protective near the end of mid-gestation - roughly weeks 19 to 26 in humans - leaving the fetus more exposed at that point.
energy_note: A two-month window, and a war does not check the calendar.

description: Van den Bergh & Marcoen found prenatal stress associated with markedly more ADHD symptoms in boys than girls; a severe-earthquake prenatal cohort found increased depression rates only in males.
energy_note: Sons take more of it, for reasons not yet settled.

aspect: What this costs a family over a lifetime
description: Assessment, therapy, specialist schooling, a parent leaving work, and adult support. Most of it is paid by the household, in a country that may not recognise the diagnosis, in a language the parents do not fully have.
energy_note: A bill that starts at age three and does not stop.

aspect: HONEST LIMIT - this is association, and the mechanism is not settled
description: Proposed mechanisms are DNA methylation and HPA-axis programming, with placental inflammatory and nutrient-sensing pathways implicated. None of this licenses telling any individual family that the war caused their child's autism. The dataset records elevated population risk.
energy_note: What is known, and firmly where it stops.
